system.description:
Why respect knights when my potions can do anything that you can?

— Justin Kuritzkes, Potion Seller

Often sequestered in a lab, alchemists study the essence of creation. They are as curious as they are resourceful, and always have "just the thing for this."

Iconic Alchemists

  • The Colorman, Sacré Bleu
  • Dr. Jekyll, Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde
  • Tessa Cade, Defy the Night
  • Walter White, Breaking Bad

Playing Alchemist

The alchemist is a low-defense, high-damage-and-utility blaster. It's recommended you stay Far from Enemies to use Alchemical Items.

Action: Use (Craft & Attack)
Move: Backline
Starting Pack: Alchemist or Assassin
Key Stat: Reason
Complexity: ★★★★☆

Training

Weapons: –
Skills: Arcana, Craft, Medicine

levelFeatures.name: Alchemy
levelFeatures.description:
Choose 4 Alchemical Items (p. 84) with a value no higher than (your Level × 50s). You only need 5s of Materials and Alchemy Tools equipped to Craft them.

You learn to Craft 1 other Alchemical Item this way every 3 Levels hereafter.

levelFeatures.name: Catalyze
levelFeatures.description: You gain the Deft Hands Perk (p. 68), and can Craft Alchemical Items with the Use Action.

levelFeatures.name: Eureka
levelFeatures.description: When you pass a Craft Check by 10 or more, you gain a Studied die (p. 19). The roll required to do so is decreased by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

levelFeatures.name: Perk
levelFeatures.description: Choose a new Perk. You must meet the prerequisites to take it, unless the Perk is granted through a Class Feature.

levelFeatures.name: Potency
levelFeatures.description: You have a +1 bonus to each of the damage and healing dice of your Alchemical Items, and they can Explode. This bonus increases by 1 every 4 Levels hereafter.

levelFeatures.name: Mix
levelFeatures.description: You can combine two Alchemical Items together with the Use Action by spending a Studied die, causing both Items to occur simultaneously when used. The combined Item goes inert at the start of your next Turn.

levelFeatures.name: Potency
levelFeatures.description: Your Potency bonus increases to +2 on each of the damage and healing dice of your Alchemical Items, and they Explode on their two highest values.

levelFeatures.name: Prima Materia
levelFeatures.description: You can spend a Studied die to Craft any Alchemical Item with a value as high as 10g without Materials.

effects.name: Alchemist Features
effects.description: Catalyze (L1), Eureka 10+/9+/8+ (L2/6/10), Potency +1 & explode highest (L4) / +2 & explode 2 highest (L8), Mix (L6), Prima Materia (L10) — all level-gated within this single effect.
